summary: Focused auth verification completed. No relevant testing skill found. Confirmed lcorreaq@gmail.com now logs in with IUDigital2026 via API and UI, old password Chocolate2026! is rejected, and UI redirects to / without visiting /change-password.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Use /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
